expires.description: Expires is when this resource expires (RFC3339).

labels.description: Labels are arbitrary key/value pairs attached to the resource.

namespace.description: Namespace is the resource namespace (usually left blank).

revision.description: Revision is used for optimistic concurrency control.

spec.description: TrustedCluster resource definition v2 from Teleport

enabled.description: Enabled is a bool that indicates if the TrustedCluster is enabled or disabled. Setting Enabled to false has a side effect of deleting the user and host certificate authority (CA).

role_map.description: RoleMap specifies role mappings to remote roles.

local.description: Local specifies local roles to map to

remote.description: Remote specifies remote role name to map from

token.description: Token is the authorization token provided by another cluster needed by this cluster to join. This field supports secret lookup. See the operator documentation for more details.

tunnel_addr.description: ReverseTunnelAddress is the address of the SSH proxy server of the cluster to join. If not set, it is derived from `<metadata.name>:<default reverse tunnel port>`.

web_proxy_addr.description: ProxyAddress is the address of the web proxy server of the cluster to join. If not set, it is derived from `<metadata.name>:<default web proxy server port>`.
